Our Biryani Masterclass last Saturday saw a full kitchen, hands chopping and stirring, aromas filling the studio, with us guiding everyone through the layers of preparing three authentic biryanis that capture a small part of the journey of this incredible dish!
Watching people learn, laugh, taste, and finally sit down to a biryani they made themselves…that’s the magic of these classes.

If you missed this one, don’t worry - we’ve got more masterclasses coming up.
Keep an eye out, drop us a message for more information and please come cook with us next time!

To get your team to slurp leave us a message

There are biryanis worth eating, and then there are biryanis worth learning the right way. 

Spend an evening exploring layers of flavour, regional traditions and timeless techniques in our immersive Biryani Masterclass, where you'll master three timeless biryanis in one evening!

From the rich aromas of Hyderabad to the distinctive flavours of Dakhani cuisine, you'll cook, learn and share a delicious meal together in our cozy little studio. 

Whether you're a passionate home cook or a lifelong biryani lover, this is a class you don't want to miss.

Come hungry, leave inspired (and well-fed)!

📍 Slurp Cooking Studio, Indiranagar 12th Main
🗓️ 19th September | 5 PM - 8 PM | ₹2,500 Class + Dinner

Limited seats available. Book now!

Team Nutanix hosted their quarterly outing at Slurp Cooking Studio, where they bonded over cooking a delicious Italian lunch together — making fresh pasta and choco lava cake from scratch, sharing lots of laughter, fun, and memories around the kitchen. Team bonding, achieved!

Corporate Cook‑Alongs at Slurp are built to bring teams together in the most human way possible — by cooking, collaborating, and sharing a meal.

It’s a time where colleagues become a kitchen crew, conversations flow without agendas, and everyone learns something new while having fun.
Whether you’re strengthening teamwork, celebrating a milestone, or just looking for a fresh way to connect, our kitchen is designed to make your team feel closer, lighter, and a little more inspired, all in the cozy confines of our studio at the heart of Indiranagar 12th Main!

Call us on 9916580506 or DM for bookings.
